reference_kind: Issuer HTML ordered nonblank row content; not PDF physical cell/span labels
scope: Development comparison of explicit source logical text envelopes against unchanged source-tagged/native policies. Logical mode disables cell coordinates, preserves authored empty rows/columns, uses only nonempty original text bounds and rejects any unclaimed nonblank glyph center inside its envelope. No invented blank geometry, reference input to extraction, normalization/row-label/ROI/budget changes or best-of selection. All profiles process complete originals. Preserve all existing observations and all failed cases. Not independent held-out acceptance.
